justification: The INVALID assessment catches a genuine algebraic error distinct from the ground-truth cardinality defect. The [proof](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1904.10482v1.pdf#page=26) defines distances from y' as m_nb' and m_na'b/a, so their difference is m_n(b'−a'b/a). Taking (a,b,a',b')=(2,1,1,1) gives m_n/2, whereas the printed expression gives m_n. Correcting the coefficient preserves the divergence argument, so the assessment overstates the downstream consequences, but the identified equality is genuinely wrong.
